styleLock.direction: premium dark-tech helmet commerce with alternating low-key studio and pale technical grid screens
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating low-key studio cyclorama on #14161C / #101319 and pale technical surfaces on #F7F7F5 hairline grid, #F2F0ED marble and #EDEDEB matte plate; one continuous two-mode system across the set
styleLock.lightingSystem: single hard directional key with strong raking side light to read shell curvature, shield edge and liner weave; crisp specular rim on shell edges and parting lines; deep falloff on low-key screens, soft bounce on pale screens; visible grounding contact shadow on every screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy dark horizon plate #14161C for opening and closing screens, matte neutral plate #EDEDEB for hardware insets, hairline graph paper #F7F7F5 for structure screens, marble band #F2F0ED for the feature matrix header
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; bold Chinese headline in 「」 at 30-40pt, small English kicker at 12-16pt, body labels 13-16pt, hairline rules and small square tick markers only; text is injected as placeholders and composited in post
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight geometric icons, one stroke weight, rendered in #FFFFFF on #1B1E23 panels, no fills, no gradients, no drop shadows
styleLock.presentationRules: the helmet is always one complete object with shell, outer shield, inner tinted visor, liner and vents intact; the same silhouette scale and baseline placement are held between screens; hero stays a front 3/4 reading angle so every later angle reads as the same object; part names stay generic to the category
noDrift: no invented certification marks, safety-standard badges or test seals
no numeric size, weight, rating or wind-resistance values baked into the image
no visible face, brand mark, watermark or QR code
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium dark-tech helmet ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of low-key field #14161C, slate panel #1B1E23, marble neutral band #F2F0ED, hairline grid paper #F7F7F5, matte neutral plate #EDEDEB, ink text #2D2D2D and one accent #C9A063; cool tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with bold Chinese headline in 「」 and a small English kicker; alternating low-key studio cyclorama and pale technical grid background system; single hard directional key with raking side light, crisp specular rim on shell edges and deep falloff, always a visible grounding contact shadow; thin-line single-weight icon system; the product is presented as one complete shell with shield, inner visor, liner and vents intact at stable scale and baseline; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 片详情长图切片的视觉语法拆解，未沿用任何原图像素。品类说明：taxonomy 无「头盔」L2，按图主体（骑行防护装备＋通勤佩戴场景）就近归入 运动户外/骑行；未选 汽车用品/配件，因为源图主体是戴在人身上的骑行护具而非车辆零件，L1/L2 字符逐字取自 taxonomy。已剥离：平台水印与站标文字、年份季节口号、正文装饰性英文填充块、六宫格里重复出现的同一条无意义英文副标、底部二维码与会员/包邮促销条、含站名的行内小标、盔顶装饰徽标（改写为通用「通风口饰件」）。全篇不写 3C/DOT/ECE 等任何安全认证、检测章、评级或试验数据，壳体材质等级也不做文字断言，改由 {selling_point_*}／{callout_*} 占位符承载；尺码、重量、风阻系数等数值一律不入图，由下游按核实的真实参数合成。镜位节奏沿用源图：一屏主张＋一屏六宫格总览＋连续五屏结构细节（壳体/气动/双镜片/通风/内衬），这是头盔详情页固有语法，各屏机位与背景互不相同。源图无佩戴场景与促销收口实拍：shot-08 为补齐买家代入的通用通勤上头镜（刻意后侧 3/4 裁切以回避可识别面部），shot-10 由源图底部促销条抽象为无价格无倒计时的通用收口，两者均已在 provenance 声明为漏斗补全而非源图证据。实际源文件夹名为「摩托头盔」，与本任务下发说明中标注的「五金」不符，主体判读以图片为准。
